name: cbcl
description: CBCL for JavaScript: the verifier (parse, verify, fold, bind, compile) as typed wrappers over the cbcl-rs WebAssembly build, and the object authoring runtime on top of it.

scripts.build: cp ../LICENSE LICENSE && tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp src/cbcl_wasm.js src/cbcl_wasm.d.ts src/cbcl_wasm_bg.wasm src/cbcl_wasm_bg.wasm.d.ts src/cbcl_wasm.provenance.json dist/
